claims.episode_span: Canada presented its methane reduction record at COP31 but experts stated the country cannot lead globally until Alberta updates its oil and gas regulations.
claims.source_title: Canada presented itself as a global leader in methane reductions at COP31. But is Alberta holding it back?
claims.supporting_quote: Canada took centre stage at COP31 last week to showcase its track record on cutting methane emissions. But some experts say the country can't be a global leader on reducing methane until Alberta, Canada's largest oil and gas producer, updates its equivalent regulations.
